blocks.zh: Section Contents / 章節目錄
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 2.1 Regulatory Guidance / 法規指引
blocks.en: 2.1 Regulatory Guidance

blocks.zh: 教學解說 / 實務觀點
blocks.en: Teaching Commentary / Practical Perspective

blocks.zh: 法規架構總覽
blocks.en: Regulatory Framework Overview

blocks.zh: 核心概念：全球無菌製造法規三大支柱
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Pillars of Global Sterile Manufacturing Regulation

blocks.zh: 無菌製造設施的設計必須同時滿足多個市場的法規要求，三大核心文件為：
blocks.en: A sterile manufacturing facility must be designed to meet the regulatory requirements of several markets at once. The three core documents are:

blocks.zh: 歐盟GMP附件一（EU GMP Annex 1）：全球最嚴格的無菌製造法規，2022年修訂版大幅強化污染控制策略（CCS）要求
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1: the strictest sterile manufacturing regulation in the world; the 2022 revision significantly strengthened the contamination control strategy (CCS) requirements

blocks.zh: FDA無菌製程指引（FDA Aseptic Guidance）：美國市場的核心要求，針對無菌製程提供具體操作指南
blocks.en: FDA Aseptic Processing Guidance: the core requirement for the US market, giving specific operating guidance for aseptic processing

blocks.zh: PIC/S：多數亞太國家（如台灣、新加坡、日本）採 PIC/S 體系，內容與歐盟 Annex 1 高度對齊
blocks.en: PIC/S: most Asia-Pacific countries (such as Taiwan, Singapore and Japan) follow the PIC/S system, whose content is closely aligned with EU Annex 1

blocks.zh: 重點提示：法規區域差異
blocks.en: Key Point: Regional Differences

blocks.zh: 各國法規之間存在「微妙與重大」的差異。例如，美國 FDA 稽查員可能會期望看到歐盟 Annex 1 的要求在美國工廠中被採用。這種「交叉期望」趨勢在全球化稽查中越來越常見。
blocks.en: There are "subtle and significant" differences between national regulations. For example, a US FDA investigator may expect to see EU Annex 1 requirements adopted at a US site. This kind of "cross-expectation" is increasingly common in global inspections.

blocks.zh: 比喻：「最嚴標準」原則
blocks.en: Analogy: The "Strictest Standard" Principle

blocks.zh: 想像不同國家的法規就像不同的考試：美國考數學、歐盟考物理、PIC/S考化學。作為全球供應商，你不能只準備一科——必須每科都達到最高標準。
blocks.en: Think of each country's regulations as a different exam: the US tests math, the EU tests physics, PIC/S tests chemistry. As a global supplier you cannot prepare for only one subject; you must reach the highest standard in every one.

blocks.zh: 法規演變與最佳實務
blocks.en: Regulatory Evolution and Best Practice

blocks.zh: 重點變化：從1999年至今的關鍵演進
blocks.en: Key Changes: The Main Developments from 1999 to Today

blocks.zh: ISPE指南列出的變化反映了行業趨勢：
blocks.en: The changes listed in the ISPE Guide reflect industry trends:

blocks.zh: 屏障技術普及：從傳統潔淨室轉向 RABS/隔離器
blocks.en: Wider use of barrier technology: a shift from conventional cleanrooms to RABS/isolators

blocks.zh: 人員管理強化：更嚴格的穿衣和移動管控
blocks.en: Stronger personnel control: stricter gowning and movement controls

blocks.zh: 氣流視覺化：強調煙霧測試與氣流模式分析
blocks.en: Airflow visualization: emphasis on smoke studies and airflow pattern analysis

blocks.zh: 半塞瓶管控：部分塞塞的瓶子必須始終保持在 ISO 5/Grade A 條件下
blocks.en: Partially stoppered vials: partially stoppered vials must be kept under ISO 5/Grade A conditions at all times

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，我們服務多個客戶，產品可能銷售到不同市場。因此：
blocks.en: As a CDMO we serve multiple clients, and products may be sold to different markets. Therefore:

blocks.zh: 設施設計應採用「最嚴標準」原則，同時滿足 FDA + EU Annex 1 + PIC/S
blocks.en: Design the facility on the "strictest standard" principle, meeting FDA + EU Annex 1 + PIC/S at the same time

blocks.zh: 建立法規情報追蹤機制，定期監控各市場法規變化
blocks.en: Set up a regulatory intelligence process to monitor regulatory changes in each market on a regular basis

blocks.zh: 客戶引進時，首先確認目標市場，據此決定設施需求
blocks.en: When onboarding a client, first confirm the target markets and determine the facility requirements accordingly

blocks.zh: 2.2 Product Requirements / 產品需求
blocks.en: 2.2 Product Requirements

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌 vs. 無菌製程
blocks.en: Terminal Sterilization vs. Aseptic Processing

blocks.zh: 比喻：餐廳食品安全
blocks.en: Analogy: Restaurant Food Safety

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌就像在廚房完成所有備料後，把整道菜放進烘箱高溫殺菌。即使備料過程不夠完美，最後的高溫處理可以補救。
blocks.en: Terminal sterilization is like finishing all the food preparation in the kitchen and then putting the whole dish in a hot oven to kill any germs. Even if the preparation was not perfect, the final heat treatment can make up for it.

blocks.zh: 無菌製程則像做壽司——每一個步驟都必須在極度清潔的環境下完成，沒有最後的「高溫補救」機會。
blocks.en: Aseptic processing is more like making sushi: every step must be done in an extremely clean environment, and there is no final "heat rescue" step.

blocks.zh: 產品特性對設施的影響
blocks.en: How Product Characteristics Affect the Facility

blocks.zh: 重點：六大產品特性決定設施需求
blocks.en: Key Point: Six Product Characteristics Drive Facility Requirements

blocks.zh: 設計階段必須提前考慮的產品特性：
blocks.en: Product characteristics that must be considered early in the design phase:

blocks.zh: 劑型：液體、懸浮液、粉末、凍乾等，直接影響設備選擇與空間配置
blocks.en: Dosage form: liquid, suspension, powder, lyophilized, etc., which directly affect equipment selection and space layout

blocks.zh: 微生物生長支持性：影響持有時間與環境控制要求
blocks.en: Ability to support microbial growth: affects hold times and environmental control requirements

blocks.zh: 毒性/放射性：需要專用設施或額外防護措施
blocks.en: Toxicity/radioactivity: requires a dedicated facility or additional protective measures

blocks.zh: 環境敏感度：光、氧、溫度、濕度敏感則需特殊設計
blocks.en: Environmental sensitivity: sensitivity to light, oxygen, temperature or humidity calls for special design

blocks.zh: 揮發性：需要密閉系統與排氣控制
blocks.en: Volatility: requires closed systems and exhaust control

blocks.zh: 生物活性：活病毒疫苗需專用設施
blocks.en: Biological activity: live virus vaccines require a dedicated facility

blocks.zh: CQA、CPP 與關鍵製程步驟
blocks.en: CQAs, CPPs and Critical Process Steps

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CQA 與 CPP 的關係
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Relationship between CQAs and CPPs

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性）是產品必須滿足的品質標準（如無菌、微粒數、內毒素）。
blocks.en: CQA (Critical Quality Attribute) is a quality standard the product must meet (such as sterility, particle count, endotoxin).

blocks.zh: CPP（關鍵製程參數）是影響 CQA 的製程條件（如溫度、時間、壓力）。
blocks.en: CPP (Critical Process Parameter) is a process condition that affects a CQA (such as temperature, time, pressure).

blocks.zh: 設施設計的目的就是確保能夠可靠地控制 CPP，進而達到 CQA 的要求。
blocks.en: The purpose of facility design is to ensure that the CPPs can be controlled reliably, so that the CQA requirements are met.

blocks.zh: ICH Q8/Q10 邏輯鏈
blocks.en: ICH Q8/Q10 Logic Chain

blocks.zh:
產品品質 = f(CQA)
CQA = f(CPP)
CPP = f(設施設計 + 製程控制)

∴ 設施設計 → CPP 控制 → CQA 達標 → 產品品質
blocks.en:
Product quality = f(CQA)
CQA = f(CPP)
CPP = f(facility design + process control)

∴ Facility design → CPP control → CQA met → Product quality

blocks.zh: 重點：無菌製程八大關鍵步驟
blocks.en: Key Point: Eight Critical Steps in Aseptic Processing

blocks.zh: 以下每個步驟都可能引入污染，必須在設計階段就納入風險評估：
blocks.en: Each of the following steps can introduce contamination and must be included in the risk assessment at the design stage:

blocks.zh: 稱量與配料
blocks.en: Weighing and dispensing

blocks.zh: 容器/蓋子滅菌與除熱原
blocks.en: Container/closure sterilization and depyrogenation

blocks.zh: 無菌連接與轉移
blocks.en: Aseptic connections and transfers

blocks.zh: 配方與無菌過濾
blocks.en: Formulation and sterile filtration

blocks.zh: 填裝與初級密封
blocks.en: Filling and primary sealing

blocks.zh: 凍乾機轉移與最終加蓋
blocks.en: Lyophilizer transfer and final capping

blocks.zh: 滅菌設備儲存與轉移
blocks.en: Storage and transfer of sterilized equipment

blocks.zh: 清潔與滅菌
blocks.en: Cleaning and sterilization

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 的多產品設施，產品需求分析特別重要：
blocks.en: Product requirements analysis is especially important for a CDMO multi-product facility:

blocks.zh: 需要考慮「最惡情境產品」來設計設施（例如：最毒的、最敏感的、最難清潔的）
blocks.en: Design the facility around the "worst-case product" (for example, the most toxic, the most sensitive, the hardest to clean)

blocks.zh: 凍乾產品需預留凍乾機空間，影響整體廠房布局
blocks.en: Lyophilized products require reserved space for the lyophilizer, which affects the overall facility layout

blocks.zh: 單一使用技術（Single-Use）可大幅減少換線清潔驗證負擔
blocks.en: Single-use technology can greatly reduce the cleaning validation burden of changeovers

blocks.zh: 未來彈性：預留增加新劑型或包裝的空間
blocks.en: Future flexibility: reserve space for adding new dosage forms or packaging

blocks.zh: 2.3 Risk Assessment / 風險評估
blocks.en: 2.3 Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 風險評估在設施設計中的角色
blocks.en: The Role of Risk Assessment in Facility Design

blocks.zh: 核心概念：ICH Q9 風險管理架構
blocks.en: Core Concept: The ICH Q9 Risk Management Framework

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 提供了系統性的風險管理方法，應用於製藥設施設計時包含六大領域：
blocks.en: ICH Q9 provides a systematic risk management approach. Applied to pharmaceutical facility design, it covers six areas:

blocks.zh: 設施/設備設計：如潔淨室分區、氣流方向
blocks.en: Facility/equipment design: such as cleanroom zoning and airflow direction

blocks.zh: 衛生面向：如表面材質、清潔可及性
blocks.en: Hygiene aspects: such as surface materials and cleaning accessibility

blocks.zh: 確認活動：IQ/OQ/PQ 的測試範圍
blocks.en: Qualification activities: the test scope of IQ/OQ/PQ

blocks.zh: 清潔與環境控制：清潔驗證與環境監控
blocks.en: Cleaning and environmental control: cleaning validation and environmental monitoring

blocks.zh: 校準/預防維護：關鍵儀器的校準頻率
blocks.en: Calibration/preventive maintenance: calibration frequency of critical instruments

blocks.zh: 電腦化系統：SCADA、BMS 等控制系統
blocks.en: Computerized systems: control systems such as SCADA and BMS

blocks.zh: RPN 風險優先數 計算公式
blocks.en: RPN (Risk Priority Number) Calculation Formula

blocks.zh:
RPN = 嚴重度 (S) x 發生機率 (O) x 可偵測性 (D)

其中：
  S (Severity)     = 1–10（危害嚴重程度）
  O (Occurrence)   = 1–10（發生機率）
  D (Detectability)= 1–10（不可偵測程度，10最難發現）

RPN 越高，需要優先處理。
超過門檻值的 RPN 必須制定緩解措施。
blocks.en:
RPN = Severity (S) x Occurrence (O) x Detectability (D)

Where:
  S (Severity)     = 1–10 (seriousness of the hazard)
  O (Occurrence)   = 1–10 (likelihood of occurrence)
  D (Detectability)= 1–10 (degree of non-detectability; 10 is hardest to detect)

The higher the RPN, the higher the priority for action.
An RPN above the threshold requires mitigation measures.

blocks.zh: 比喻：風險評估就像買保險
blocks.en: Analogy: Risk Assessment Is Like Buying Insurance

blocks.zh: 想像你在評估一棟房子的風險：
blocks.en: Imagine you are assessing the risks of a house:

blocks.zh: 嚴重度：如果房子着火，損失多大？
blocks.en: Severity: if the house catches fire, how big is the loss?

blocks.zh: 發生機率：這個地區多常發生火災？
blocks.en: Occurrence: how often do fires occur in this area?

blocks.zh: 可偵測性：有沒有煙霧警報器能及早發現？
blocks.en: Detectability: is there a smoke alarm to detect it early?

blocks.zh: 製藥設施的風險評估邀輯完全相同——評估每個風險點，然後決定需要多少「保險」（工程或程序控制）。
blocks.en: Risk assessment for a pharmaceutical facility follows exactly the same logic: assess each risk point, then decide how much "insurance" (engineering or procedural controls) is needed.

blocks.zh: 重點：工程解決方案優先於程序解決方案
blocks.en: Key Point: Engineered Solutions Take Priority over Procedural Solutions

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調：應優先考慮「工程解決方案」（Engineered Solutions）而非依賴「程序解決方案」（Procedural Solutions）。
blocks.en: ISPE emphasizes that "Engineered Solutions" should be considered first, rather than relying on "Procedural Solutions".

blocks.zh: 例如：
blocks.en: For example:

blocks.zh: 工程解決：安裝隔離器阻隔人員與產品接觸
blocks.en: Engineered solution: install an isolator to keep personnel from contacting the product

blocks.zh: 程序解決：SOP 要求人員穿戴無菌手套
blocks.en: Procedural solution: an SOP requiring personnel to wear sterile gloves

blocks.zh: 工程解決更可靠，因為不依賴人員執行的一致性。
blocks.en: Engineered solutions are more reliable because they do not depend on consistent execution by people.

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Exercise

blocks.zh: 在一條新的無菌填裝線設計中，如果你發現「人員在填裝區的介入頻率」的 RPN 超過門檻值，你會建議哪種緩解措施？
blocks.en: In the design of a new aseptic filling line, you find that the RPN for "frequency of operator interventions in the filling area" exceeds the threshold. Which mitigation would you recommend?

blocks.zh: A. 加強人員無菌技術培訓（程序解決）
blocks.en: A. Strengthen personnel aseptic technique training (procedural solution)

blocks.zh: B. 導入 RABS 或隔離器減少介入（工程解決）
blocks.en: B. Introduce RABS or an isolator to reduce interventions (engineered solution)

blocks.zh: C. 增加環境監控頻率（可偵測性改善）
blocks.en: C. Increase the frequency of environmental monitoring (improves detectability)

blocks.zh: 最佳策略通常是 B 優先，輔以 A 和 C。
blocks.en: The best strategy is usually B first, supported by A and C.

blocks.zh: 2.4 Risk Mitigation / "Quality by Design" / 風險緩解與「品質源於設計」
blocks.en: 2.4 Risk Mitigation / "Quality by Design"

blocks.zh: QbD 在設施設計中的應用
blocks.en: Applying QbD in Facility Design

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Quality by Design（品質源於設計）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Quality by Design

blocks.zh: QbD 的核心理念是：品質不是檢驗出來的，而是設計進去的。應用於設施設計時：
blocks.en: The core idea of QbD is: quality is not inspected in, it is designed in. Applied to facility design:

blocks.zh: 理解生產需求：先明確要生產什麼、怎麼生產
blocks.en: Understand production needs: first define clearly what is to be made and how

blocks.zh: 辨識風險：哪些生產步驟可能影響品質
blocks.en: Identify risks: which production steps could affect quality

blocks.zh: 納入設計：將緩解措施融入設施設計
blocks.en: Build into the design: incorporate mitigation measures into the facility design

blocks.zh: 驗證確認：通過確認活動驗證設計意圖已實現
blocks.en: Verify and confirm: use qualification activities to verify that the design intent has been achieved

blocks.zh: 比喻：蓋房子 vs. 消防安全
blocks.en: Analogy: Building a House vs. Fire Safety

blocks.zh: 想像你在蓋一棟大樓：
blocks.en: Imagine you are constructing a building:

blocks.zh: 傳統做法：先蓋好，然後檢查是否符合消防法規，不符合就改
blocks.en: Traditional approach: build it first, then check compliance with fire codes and fix whatever does not comply

blocks.zh: QbD 做法：從設計階段就把消防通道、灑水系統、防火材料融入建築設計
blocks.en: QbD approach: build fire escape routes, sprinkler systems and fire-resistant materials into the building design from the design stage

blocks.zh: QbD 在製藥設施中就是後者——從一開始就把品質控制設計進設施中。
blocks.en: In a pharmaceutical facility, QbD is the latter: quality control is designed into the facility from the very beginning.

blocks.zh: CDMO 設施的 QbD 特別挑戰：
blocks.en: Particular QbD challenges for a CDMO facility:

blocks.zh: 必須同時滿足多個客戶的品質需求，設計應基於最嚴格的需求
blocks.en: It must meet the quality needs of several clients at once, so the design should be based on the most demanding requirements

blocks.zh: 彈性設計很重要：今天生產蛋白質藥物，明天可能是細胞治療
blocks.en: Flexible design is important: protein drugs today, possibly cell therapy tomorrow

blocks.zh: 設施生命週期內的法規變化需納入考量（如 Annex 1 修訂）
blocks.en: Regulatory changes over the facility lifecycle must be taken into account (such as the Annex 1 revision)

blocks.zh: 設計階段的投資可以避免生產階段的巨額失敗成本
blocks.en: Investment at the design stage can avoid huge failure costs during production

blocks.zh: 2.5 Contamination Control Approaches / 污染控制方法
blocks.en: 2.5 Contamination Control Approaches

blocks.zh: 污染控制：無菌設施的核心任務
blocks.en: Contamination Control: The Core Task of a Sterile Facility

blocks.zh: 核心概念：兩種污染類型
blocks.en: Core Concept: Two Types of Contamination

blocks.zh: 環境污染（Environmental Contamination）：來自周圍環境的微粒、微生物或異物入侵
blocks.en: Environmental contamination: ingress of particles, microorganisms or foreign matter from the surrounding environment

blocks.zh: 交叉污染（Cross-Contamination）：一個產品的成分混入另一個產品
blocks.en: Cross-contamination: components of one product mixing into another product

blocks.zh: 每一個受污染的容器都可能嚴重傷害患者——這是無菌製造的最基本信念。
blocks.en: Every contaminated container can seriously harm a patient; this is the most basic principle of sterile manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 巢狀製造區概念
blocks.en: The Nested Manufacturing Zones Concept

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Nested Manufacturing Zones（巢狀製造區）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Nested Manufacturing Zones

blocks.zh: 無菌設施的空間配置遵循「由外到內、逐層淨化」的原則：
blocks.en: The spatial layout of a sterile facility follows the principle of "from the outside in, purifying layer by layer":

blocks.zh: 外部環境 / Unclassified
blocks.en: External environment / Unclassified

blocks.zh: Grade D / ISO 8（支援區）
blocks.en: Grade D / ISO 8 (support area)

blocks.zh: Grade C / ISO 7（準備區）
blocks.en: Grade C / ISO 7 (preparation area)

blocks.zh: Grade B / ISO 5（背景區）
blocks.en: Grade B / ISO 5 (background area)

blocks.zh: Grade A / ISO 5（填裝區 — 核心）
blocks.en: Grade A / ISO 5 (filling area, the core)

blocks.zh: 每一層轉換都需要「改善步驟」：物料清潔、人員更衣、氣壓階梯等。
blocks.en: Each transition between layers requires an "improvement step": material cleaning, personnel gowning, pressure cascades, and so on.

blocks.zh: 三大污染控制技術
blocks.en: Three Main Contamination Control Technologies

blocks.zh: 比喻：手術室的無菌層級
blocks.en: Analogy: Levels of Sterility in the Operating Room

blocks.zh: 想像三種手術室設置：
blocks.en: Imagine three operating room setups:

blocks.zh: 傳統潔淨室：醫生在潔淨房間裡直接操作，全靠手套和無菌技術
blocks.en: Conventional cleanroom: the surgeon works directly in a clean room, relying entirely on gloves and aseptic technique

blocks.zh: RABS：醫生透過一層透明屏障操作，可透過手套孔介入
blocks.en: RABS: the surgeon works through a transparent barrier and can intervene through glove ports

blocks.zh: 隔離器：醫生透過完全密封的手套箱操作，與產品完全隔離
blocks.en: Isolator: the surgeon works through a fully sealed glove box, completely separated from the product

blocks.zh: 隔離等級越高，對人員無菌技術的依賴越低。
blocks.en: The higher the level of separation, the less the reliance on personnel aseptic technique.

blocks.zh: 重點：有效環境控制的五大要素
blocks.en: Key Point: Five Elements of Effective Environmental Control

blocks.zh: 空氣過濾控制：HEPA 過濾器，確保空氣潔淨度
blocks.en: Air filtration control: HEPA filters ensure air cleanliness

blocks.zh: 氣流模式確定：單向氣流（UAF）在關鍵區域提供保護
blocks.en: Defined airflow pattern: unidirectional airflow (UAF) protects critical zones

blocks.zh: 溫濕度控制：影響微生物生長和產品穩定性
blocks.en: Temperature and humidity control: affects microbial growth and product stability

blocks.zh: 內部污染稀釋/排除：通過換氣次數控制
blocks.en: Dilution/removal of internally generated contamination: controlled through air change rates

blocks.zh: 區域隔離：物理分隔、壓差控制、氣流方向控制
blocks.en: Zone separation: physical separation, pressure differential control and airflow direction control

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用：多產品設施的污染控制
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Application: Contamination Control in a Multi-Product Facility

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 的多產品設施，污染控制是最大挑戰：
blocks.en: For a CDMO multi-product facility, contamination control is the biggest challenge:

blocks.zh: 環境污染：推薦採用隔離器或 RABS，降低對人員無菌技術的依賴
blocks.en: Environmental contamination: isolators or RABS are recommended to reduce reliance on personnel aseptic technique

blocks.zh: 交叉污染：應建立基於風險的清潔驗證策略，特別是高毒性/高效產品
blocks.en: Cross-contamination: establish a risk-based cleaning validation strategy, especially for highly toxic/highly potent products

blocks.zh: 專用設施：對於細胞治療、活病毒疫苗等高風險產品，可能需要專用生產區域
blocks.en: Dedicated facilities: high-risk products such as cell therapies and live virus vaccines may require dedicated production areas

blocks.zh: 單一使用技術：大幅減少交叉污染風險，特別適合多產品切換
blocks.en: Single-use technology: greatly reduces cross-contamination risk, and is especially suitable for frequent product changeovers

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 設施需要同時生產一個高效致敏藥物和一個普通注射劑。你會如何設計設施布局？
blocks.en: Your CDMO facility must manufacture a highly potent sensitizing drug and an ordinary injectable at the same time. How would you design the facility layout?

blocks.zh: 考慮：空氣處理系統是否需要獨立？
blocks.en: Consider: does the air handling system need to be independent?

blocks.zh: 考慮：人員、物料流向如何設計？
blocks.en: Consider: how should personnel and material flows be designed?

blocks.zh: 考慮：清潔驗證策略如何制定？
blocks.en: Consider: how should the cleaning validation strategy be set?

blocks.zh: 考慮：是否需要專用生產線？
blocks.en: Consider: is a dedicated production line needed?

blocks.zh: 教學解說
blocks.en: Teaching Commentary

blocks.zh: 三大污染類型對應策略
blocks.en: Strategies for the Three Types of Contamination

blocks.zh: 非活性微粒：主要來自人員、設備磨損、空氣系統。核心對策是 HEPA 過濾+屏障技術+自動化
blocks.en: Non-viable particles: mainly from personnel, equipment wear and air systems. The core countermeasures are HEPA filtration + barrier technology + automation

blocks.zh: 活性微生物：最大來源是人員。隔離器和 RABS 是最有效的工程控制
blocks.en: Viable microorganisms: personnel are the largest source. Isolators and RABS are the most effective engineering controls

blocks.zh: 內毒素：與水和濕度密切相關。除熱原需要高溫（>250°C）或化學處理
blocks.en: Endotoxin: closely related to water and humidity. Depyrogenation requires high temperature (>250°C) or chemical treatment

blocks.zh: 重點：人員是最大污染源
blocks.en: Key Point: Personnel Are the Largest Source of Contamination

blocks.zh: 在無菌環境中，人員是微粒和微生物的最大來源。這就是為什麼：
blocks.en: In an aseptic environment, personnel are the largest source of particles and microorganisms. This is why:

blocks.zh: 隔離器和 RABS 被強烈推薦（減少人員接觸）
blocks.en: Isolators and RABS are strongly recommended (to reduce personnel contact)

blocks.zh: 自動化和機器人技術正在快速發展
blocks.en: Automation and robotics are developing rapidly

blocks.zh: 穿衣培訓和無菌技術培訓至關重要
blocks.en: Gowning training and aseptic technique training are essential

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 章節總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 重點回顧
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 法規架構：設施設計必須同時滿足多個市場的 GMP 要求。稽查員越來越頻繁地採用「交叉期望」標準。
blocks.en: Regulatory framework: facility design must meet GMP requirements of several markets at once. Inspectors increasingly apply "cross-expectation" standards.

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌 vs. 無菌製程：終端滅菌是法規首選。選擇哪種路徑決定了設施的根本設計方向。
blocks.en: Terminal sterilization vs. aseptic processing: terminal sterilization is the regulatory preference. Which route is chosen determines the fundamental design direction of the facility.

blocks.zh: CQA-CPP-設施鏈：產品品質屬性驅動製程參數，製程參數驅動設施設計。必須從設計階段開始文件化。
blocks.en: CQA-CPP-facility chain: product quality attributes drive process parameters, and process parameters drive facility design. This must be documented from the design stage.

blocks.zh: 風險導向設計：使用 FMECA、HACCP 等工具系統性評估風險。工程解決方案始終優先於程序解決方案。
blocks.en: Risk-based design: use tools such as FMECA and HACCP to assess risk systematically. Engineered solutions always take priority over procedural solutions.

blocks.zh: 品質源於設計：從設計階段就將品質控制融入設施，而非事後檢測。
blocks.en: Quality by Design: build quality control into the facility from the design stage, rather than testing for it afterwards.

blocks.zh: 污染控制階層：隔離器 > RABS > 傳統潔淨室。新建設施應採用屏障技術。「巢狀區域」概念是基本原則。
blocks.en: Contamination control hierarchy: isolator > RABS > conventional cleanroom. New facilities should adopt barrier technology. The "nested zones" concept is a fundamental principle.

blocks.zh: 交叉污染：多產品設施必須針對四大路徑（混淆、殘留、機械轉移、氣傳）建立控制措施。
blocks.en: Cross-contamination: a multi-product facility must establish controls for the four pathways (mix-up, retention, mechanical transfer, airborne transfer).
